definitions.explanation: The study or acquisition of foreign languages.

examples.japanese: {語学|ごがく}が{得意|とくい}だ。
{語学|ごがく}{留学|りゅうがく}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go study abroad for language learning.

examples.japanese: {語学|ごがく}{力|りょく}を{磨|みが}く。
{語学|ごがく}の{習得|しゅうとく}には{時間|じかん}と{努力|どりょく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。しかし、{継続|けいぞく}すれば{必|かなら}ず{上達|じょうたつ}する。
examples.english: Acquiring a language requires time and effort. However, if you continue, you will definitely improve.

notes:
{語学|ごがく} refers to language study and language ability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {語学|ごがく}を{学|まな}ぶ (to study languages)
- {語学|ごがく}が{堪能|たんのう}だ (to be proficient in languages)
- {語学|ごがく}{力|りょく} (language proficiency)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {語学|ごがく}{学校|がっこう} (language school)
- {語学|ごがく}{留学|りゅうがく} (study abroad for language learning)
- {語学|ごがく}{研修|けんしゅう} (language training)
- {語学|ごがく}{試験|しけん} (language test)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {語学|ごがく}: language study/ability (general)
- {外国|がいこく}{語|ご}: foreign language
- {言語|げんご}{学|がく}: linguistics (academic field)
